{
  "status": "PASS",
  "target_task": "BACKLOG-108",
  "patch_text": "diff --git a/backend/services/chat_orchestrator.py b/backend/services/chat_orchestrator.py
index abc123..def456 100644
--- a/backend/services/chat_orchestrator.py
+++ b/backend/services/chat_orchestrator.py
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 from backend.services.contact_manager import ContactManager
 from backend.services.memory_extractor import MemoryExtractor
+from backend.data.crud import update_contact
 
 class ChatOrchestrator:
     def __init__(self, contact_manager: ContactManager, memory_extractor: MemoryExtractor):
@@ -45,6 +46,12 @@ class ChatOrchestrator:
         if contact_match.confidence >= 0.8:
             # confirmed existing contact
-            # TODO: persist confirmed facts to contact record
+            contact_id = contact_match.contact_id
+            confirmed_facts = self._extract_confirmed_facts(chat_message)
+            if confirmed_facts:
+                update_contact(contact_id, confirmed_facts)
+                self.contact_manager.notify_contact_updated(contact_id)
+            else:
+                self.contact_manager.propose_contact_update(contact_id, chat_message)
         else:
             self.contact_manager.propose_new_contact(chat_message)
@@ -52,3 +59,8 @@ class ChatOrchestrator:
     def _extract_confirmed_facts(self, chat_message):
         return self.memory_extractor.extract_facts(chat_message)
+
+    def _extract_confirmed_facts(self, chat_message):
+        """Extract confirmed contact facts from a chat message."""
+        facts = self.memory_extractor.extract_facts(chat_message)
+        return [f for f in facts if f.get('type') == 'contact' and f.get('confidence', 0) >= 0.8]
",
  "notes": "Minimal patch: adds persistence path for confirmed contact facts when an existing contact is matched with high confidence. Falls back to proposal path when no high-confidence facts are extracted. Touches only chat_orchestrator.py and adds import from crud.py. No other files changed.",
  "changed_files": ["backend/services/chat_orchestrator.py"],
  "risk_list": ["Low risk: only adds persistence call for high-confidence facts; no change to existing proposal or memory-only paths"]
}
